status: pre-run evaluation key; withheld from performers by instruction, not a security boundary
precedence: W: any materially false operational claim or invented evidence, even if other facets correct
A: no substantive answer to the question, including blanket refusal without supported limitation
C: all listed facets substantively correct with supporting source citations; equivalent wording accepted
P: some correct substantive facets and no materially false claim, but missing facets or unsupported/missing citations
citation_rule: Each question must cite at least one pinned source URL with source-file line anchors covering its supported answer. A malformed/irrelevant citation without a false substantive claim downgrades to P; invented source content is W. No exact anchor equality required.
unknown_rule: Q7/Q8 explicitly request limits: supported statements that numbers/adoption are not established are responsive C facets, not abstentions. An unanswered answerable part remains missing. Do not count a mere unknown assertion as full credit if required supported operational facts are omitted.

facets: manifest then opportunities then selected context_path; resolve root-relative paths
requesting_help distinguishes current help from historical closed questions
read_live/source Issues because snapshot/comment omission
empty artifacts does not prove no reusable evidence; inspect prose/live comments
ordinary GitHub comment with correction/evidence or uncertainty is sufficient
user authorization to post required
no checkout, official assignment, prior maintainer approval or intent required
intents optional and nonexclusive, cannot reserve
own repository allowed; follow contribution/review templates (or describe required community opt-in and structured record markers); contribution links question and fixed commit
artifact_version lowercase 40-character SHA; artifact_url GitHub HTTPS blob/tree/commit containing same SHA without credentials/query/fragment
review links contribution and exact full URL plus SHA
four scopes reproducibility/data/method/conclusion; supported/concerns/not_checked; evidence required for supported and concerns verdicts in all four scopes
new revision requires own reviews; changed URL/SHA invalidates applicability, same SHA other path cannot inherit
bounded recent 100-comment metadata window not complete archive; empty/unavailable/failure distinguished
fetch selected issue comments via documented GitHub API or authorized gh, follow pagination to exhaustion
label partial fetch incomplete; source count not atomic guarantee
retain exact URL, author, timestamps, retrieval time and relied-on content; mutable sources caveat
same-account review cannot claim independence; separate accounts/declared affiliations not proof of independent operators
open community review is assertion not official acceptance
official review needs different session and existing authorized role, then coordinator acceptance after reviewed merged artifact; second session alone cannot accept
owner mbabby retains deployment/moderation; governance draft inactive, no transferred credentials/credit/authority
update structured verdict/evidence or outcome fields, plus dated explanation with reason/evidence and exact affected URL/version; prose alone insufficient
withdraw by removing community marker; successful refresh needed; closing alone insufficient
GitHub history/downloads/third-party copies may remain
exports omit comment bodies/external artifacts; preserve exact sources/comments plus update/retrieval times and artifact URL/commit, attribution and applicable rights
no exact payment, guaranteed response deadline or measured onboarding time established in packet
community records grant no credit reward/authority, rather than inventing reward quantity
ask relevant maintainer/question author for missing terms and measure actual task effort if needed; no invented estimate or guarantee
attributable actual external reuse/useful correction/continued unfinished work with evidence; technical checks or activity counts insufficient
packet is standards/docs, does not establish quantity of adoption or savings; no claim zero real-world adoption

bounded next action select at most one relevant question, inspect pinned version and live discussion, explain reusable evidence/unknowns, propose authorized small action; no automatic posting/execution

pilot_usable_threshold: At least 7 C of 8, zero W, Q2/Q3/Q5/Q6 all C, and all eight questions substantively attempted. This is a local document-usability gate only, NOT formal/independent acceptance.

metrics.zero_denominators: null/N/A; final metric uses prior study published AA denominator only, not a claim to run AA benchmark

review: Review raw first outputs before any repair. Score per-question with rationale/source and quote brief evidence. Separate same-operator reviewer checks scores. Resolve disagreements transparently, preserve initial labels. No hidden post-output threshold changes.
